kultivator.dpower.tab.no_talent: No talent. Most disciples have none, and that is no shame.
kultivator.dpower.btn.fusion.desc: While its Fire Lotus charges, a Fire Dao master within 6 blocks pours in their own flame: 5 U × flames in a radius of 6. Costs 30%% of your maximum qi.
kultivator.dpower.fusion.source: Source: Battle Through the Heavens: the first lotus fused Xiao Yan's flame with his master Yao Lao's Bone Chilling Flame.
kultivator.dpower.btn.burst.desc: For 20 s every blow deals ×(1 + 0.25 × open gates). Then 30 s of Weakness and +30%% damage taken. Cooldown 5 minutes. Bursts by itself below half health in a boss fight.
kultivator.dpower.colour.tip: The colour of its soul realm sets how fast it gathers cultivation (Red ×0.6 up to Indigo ×1.7). A Red realm cannot break out of Golden Core Peak and keeps only half of what overflows its bar. Good fortune lifts the colour one step: a Marrow Cleansing Pill, or meditating within 8 blocks of you while you meditate (1%% a minute).
kultivator.dpower.colour.source: Source: Tales of Demons and Gods, ch. 13-14: seven soul realm colours from red to indigo; Teacher Shen Xiu claims a red realm caps soul force at 600 unless fortuitous circumstances occur, and Nie Li insists no soul realm is crippled.
kultivator.dpower.colour.fortune: Good fortune! Meditating beside you, %s found a fortuitous encounter.
kultivator.dpower.why.red_cap: Its red soul realm holds it at Golden Core Peak
kultivator.dpower.talent.persevering.des: Meditation and duty cultivation ×1.3, Foundation chance +8%%, tribulation strikes ×0.9.
kultivator.dpower.talent.persevering.sou: Source: A Record of a Mortal's Journey to Immortality: Han Li rises through persistence on a poor pseudo root.
kultivator.dpower.talent.ancient_god.des: Its realm's health bonus ×1.5 and melee ×1.3. Its star health grows ×1.5 and its first calamity waits until star 8.
kultivator.dpower.talent.ancient_god.sou: Source: Renegade Immortal: Wang Lin inherits the Ancient God Tu Si; Ancient Gods grow by stars, and Tu Si met his first trial at eight stars.
kultivator.dpower.talent.pill_gift.desc: Cultivation from fed pills ×1.3 and pill cooldowns 30%% shorter.
kultivator.dpower.talent.pill_gift.sourc: Source: I Shall Seal the Heavens: Meng Hao's gift for alchemy makes him the Pill Demon's disciple.
kultivator.dpower.talent.spirit_enhancer: Natal treasure enhancement +15%% success and one more fold (19).
Source: A Will Eternal: Bai Xiaochun's gift for spirit enhancement.
kultivator.dpower.talent.fear_of_death.d: Runs back to you at 40%% health and heals twice as fast while that low. Undying Codex points ×2.
kultivator.dpower.talent.fear_of_death.s: Source: A Will Eternal: Bai Xiaochun's overwhelming fear of death.
kultivator.dpower.talent.sword_sense.des: Against monsters holding a sword: dodges 30%% of their blows and gains ×1.5 comprehension from slaying them. After 20 such kills, +10%% sword damage (melee, and the techniques of the Sword Dao).
kultivator.dpower.talent.sword_sense.sou: Source: Absolute Sword Sense: Soh Woonhwi hears weapons and reads their wielders' styles.
kultivator.dpower.sword_sense.mastery: %s has read twenty sword styles: +10%% sword damage from now on.
kultivator.dpower.special.beggar.short: Revealed: a heavenly root, an Indigo soul and the innate Plum Blossom Sword.
kultivator.dpower.special.beggar.desc: Arrived as a ragged boy with a Trash root. At Foundation Establishment he showed what he truly is: a heavenly root, an Indigo soul, +30 comprehension in the Sword Dao (+10 in another Dao) and the Twenty-Four Plum Blossom Sword without the lost scripture.
kultivator.dpower.special.beggar.source: Source: Return of the Mount Hua Sect: the Plum Blossom Sword Saint is reborn as a ragged beggar boy, joins as a lowly third-generation disciple and is secretly the greatest swordsman.
kultivator.dpower.special.regressor.desc: Remembers the realm of a past life (Golden Core to Dao Union). Until it reaches that realm again: cultivation ×1.6, every breakthrough at least Perfect, tribulation strikes ×0.8.
kultivator.dpower.special.regressor.sour: Source: Volcanic Age: a mediocre Mount Hua elder is sent back to his youth on his deathbed with his memories. Absolute Sword Sense: Soh Woonhwi regresses ten years.
kultivator.dpower.special.regressor.acti: cultivation ×1.6, breakthroughs at least Perfect, strikes ×0.8
kultivator.dpower.special.regressor.done: its past life is behind it
kultivator.dpower.special.blocked_dantia: Only Body techniques; a body like iron.

Its dantian cannot store energy, so it trains the body: only Body Dao techniques, melee ×1.6, its realm's health bonus ×1.5, kill cultivation ×1.4, star-qi meditation ×1.5, no Qi Deviation from a failed breakthrough, and the Undying Codex for free.
Source: Stellar Transformations: Qin Yu's dantian cannot store energy, so he trains the body and becomes mighty.
kultivator.dpower.special.hidden.desc: He looks like the poorest talent there is. Only the way he holds a stick seems strange.
kultivator.dpower.beggar.reveal: The ragged boy was never a beggar: %s reveals a heavenly root, an Indigo soul and the Plum Blossom Sword!
kultivator.dpower.beggar.sword: %s takes up the Sword Dao as if remembering it: +%s comprehension.
kultivator.dpower.beggar.dao: %s grasps its new Dao with uncanny ease: +%s comprehension.
kultivator.dpower.blocked.no_deviation: %s's blocked dantian holds no qi that could run wild: no Qi Deviation.
kultivator.dpower.why.blocked_dantian: Its dantian is blocked: it can only learn Body Dao techniques
kultivator.dpower.physique.none: No rare physique. Few are born with one.
kultivator.dpower.physique.hidden: Nothing unusual shows in its veins... yet.
kultivator.dpower.physique.poison.short: Immune to poison and wither; its blows poison. A poison aura from Foundation; the Seven-Coloured Poison Mist from Deity Transformation.
kultivator.dpower.physique.poison.desc: Immune to Poison and Wither; its melee adds Poison II for 4 s. From Foundation an aura deals 0.3 U a second within 4 blocks. Fighting fills a toxin meter (+1 a minute); at 100 the poison rages for 60 s (aura ×2, even while following you). A Healing Pill empties the meter. From Deity Transformation: Seven-Coloured Poison Mist, a 6-block cloud for 8 s (Poison III, Wither II), every 45 s. Monsters only.
kultivator.dpower.physique.poison.source: Source: Battle Through the Heavens: the Little Fairy Doctor's Woeful Poison Body and Seven-Colored Poison Manual; it grows out of control until Xiao Yan's Poison Pill gives her a normal life.
kultivator.dpower.physique.taixu.short: Pills ×1.5 and half their cooldown. Dragon Form from Nascent Soul.
kultivator.dpower.physique.taixu.desc: Cultivation from pills ×1.5, pill cooldowns halved. From Nascent Soul: Dragon Form for 20 s (larger when there is head room, +50%% damage, no knockback, a 6-block cone of dragon flame for 1.2 U a second that sets monsters burning for 3 s), every 120 s. Monsters only.
kultivator.dpower.physique.taixu.source: Source: Battle Through the Heavens: Zi Yan, a young Taixu Ancient Dragon in human form, devours pills and takes dragon form.
kultivator.dpower.physique.dou_di.short: +0.12 quality on every breakthrough. Awakens at Dao Union.
kultivator.dpower.physique.dou_di.desc: +0.12 quality score on every breakthrough. At Dao Union the bloodline awakens once: +15%% to all stats and one stage higher.
kultivator.dpower.physique.dou_di.source: Source: Battle Through the Heavens: the Xiao clan's ancient Dou Di bloodline, awakened later by Xiao Yan.
kultivator.dpower.physique.golden_body.s: Grows stronger from every beating it survives.
kultivator.dpower.physique.golden_body.d: Every 10 damage taken gives a Golden Blood stack (up to 40, one fades every 30 s): +1.5%% damage and +0.5%% damage reduction each. Every 500 damage survived: +0.5 max health for good (up to +30).
kultivator.dpower.physique.golden_body.s: Source: Martial Peak: Yang Kai's Proud Golden Body grows stronger through the beatings he endures.
kultivator.dpower.physique.devouring.sho: Kills give +25%% cultivation and heal it.
kultivator.dpower.physique.devouring.des: Each slain monster gives +25%% cultivation and heals 5%% of the victim's max health. Opens a devouring art of the destroyer's path.
kultivator.dpower.physique.devouring.sou: Source: Martial Universe: Lin Dong carries the Devouring Ancestral Symbol.
An innate bone art of its main element, ×1.5 power.

From Foundation it casts an innate bone art of its root's main element (Metal Sword Qi, Wood Life Drain, Water and Ice Frost Lotus, Fire Flame Palm, Lightning Thunder Palm, Earth Mountain Stomp, Wind Gale, Space Space Prison) at ×1.5 power: no slot, any Dao, never taught. Kill cultivation ×1.25. At star 9 the bone sheds: ×2.25.
Source: Perfect World: Shi Hao's innate Supreme Bone with bone-text techniques; ch. 1996, after losing bones he forms an even stronger bone text.
kultivator.dpower.physique.double_pupils: Dodges a quarter of monster blows; marks monsters for you.
Dodges 25%% of monster melee, technique damage ×1.2. Every 10 s the monsters within 16 blocks get an eye mark that only you can see.
Source: Perfect World: Shi Yi's Double Pupils fire swords and beams of light.
kultivator.dpower.physique.heretic.short: Seven gates, each +15%% damage; Gate Burst.
kultivator.dpower.physique.heretic.desc: Looked like a Red Trash root until Golden Core, then opened: Indigo with a factor of 2.0. Seven gates open at Golden Core, Nascent Soul, Deity Transformation, Dao Union, Immortal Ascension layer 5, True Immortal and star 9; each gives +15%% damage. Gate Burst: 20 s at ×(1 + 0.25 × gates), then 30 s weak and +30%% damage taken, every 5 minutes.
kultivator.dpower.physique.heretic.sourc: Source: Against the Gods, ch. 45-47: Yun Che's veins look absolutely ordinary until all 54 entrances open; ch. 46: seven gates in the core of the veins, each opened gate raising the Heretic God Arts one realm, classed Berserk, and opening one too early can kill.
kultivator.dpower.physique.attributeless: Slow at first, then the fastest; techniques of every Dao.
Cultivation ×0.8 before Golden Core and ×1.4 from Dao Union. Learns and casts techniques of every Dao.
Source: Tales of Demons and Gods, ch. 14: Nie Li's attributeless red realm suits the Heavenly God technique, slow at first, highest potential, able to wield techniques of every attribute.
kultivator.dpower.poison.calmed: The Healing Pill calms the poison in %s's body.
kultivator.dpower.poison.rampage: The poison in %s's body runs out of control: it rages for 60 seconds!
kultivator.dpower.bone.shed: %s's Supreme Bone sheds and forms an even stronger bone text!
kultivator.dpower.dou_di.awaken: The ancient Dou Di bloodline awakens in %s: every stat +15%%!
kultivator.dpower.heretic.reveal: %s's ordinary-looking veins open: the Heretic God Veins! Its soul blazes Indigo.
kultivator.dpower.heretic.gate: %s opens gate %s of the Heretic God Veins: %s.
kultivator.dpower.heretic.burst: %s tears open %s gates: Gate Burst, damage at %s for 20 seconds!
kultivator.dpower.heretic.burst_ordered: At your word %s tears open %s gates: damage at %s for 20 seconds!
kultivator.dpower.heretic.exhausted: %s pays for the open gates: weak and vulnerable for 30 seconds.
kultivator.dpower.why.no_gates: No Heretic God gate is open
kultivator.dpower.ult.none.desc: A disciple gains the signature ultimate of its Dao at Nascent Soul. It must choose a Dao first.
kultivator.dpower.ult.auto: Cast by itself when a boss or 3 monsters are within 12 blocks. Hits monsters only and is never centred within 4 blocks of you or a villager.
kultivator.dpower.ult.sword.desc: 12 flying swords (24 at Deity Transformation, 36 at Dao Union, 72 from Immortal Ascension) weave a 10-block dome net over the target for 6 s: 0.4 U to every monster inside each half second. Cooldown 120 s.
kultivator.dpower.ult.sword.source: Source: A Record of a Mortal's Journey to Immortality: Han Li's 72 Azure Bamboo Cloudswarm Swords; the Great Geng Sword Formation (Da Geng Jian Zhen).
kultivator.dpower.ult.lightning.desc: Golden bolts strike up to 6 monsters for 2.5 U each (×1.5 against the undead), each chaining once to a monster within 6 blocks for 1.25 U. Bolts of light only: no fire, no real lightning. Cooldown 120 s.
kultivator.dpower.ult.lightning.source: Source: A Record of a Mortal's Journey to Immortality: the Evil-Dispelling Divine Lightning carried by the Golden Thunder Bamboo.
kultivator.dpower.ult.space.desc: A cube of restriction glyphs (radius 7) seals the target: the monsters inside cannot move, suffer Weakness V and take 1 U a second for 4 s. Cooldown 120 s.
kultivator.dpower.ult.space.source: Source: Renegade Immortal, ch. 216: Wang Lin's restrictions.
kultivator.dpower.ult.body.desc: One punch of 6 × its attack damage, then a 4-block shockwave of 2 U around the target. Cooldown 120 s.
kultivator.dpower.ult.body.source: Source: A Will Eternal: the Undying Emperor's Fist, secret art of Undying Bones.
kultivator.dpower.ult.fire.desc: Charges for 4 s, then throws a fire lotus up to 24 blocks: a burst of flame of radius 4 (6 with two or more Heavenly Flames) for 3 U × flames that sets monsters burning for 6 s. Light and fire only on creatures, never on blocks. Cooldown 45 s.
kultivator.dpower.ult.fire.source: Source: Battle Through the Heavens: Xiao Yan's self-made lotus from fusing Heavenly Flames, more explosive with each flame added.
kultivator.dpower.ult.life.desc: Drains the monsters within 10 blocks for 1.5 U each, heals itself fully and you and its fellow disciples within 10 blocks by 30%%, then +30%% damage for 30 s. Cooldown 120 s.
kultivator.dpower.ult.life.source: Source: Martial Universe: the Great Desolation Scripture gathers life force into one body.
kultivator.dpower.ult.ice.desc: The Ice Dao's book technique cast at +60%% damage and twice the radius. Cooldown 120 s.
kultivator.dpower.ult.ice.source: Source: no new concept; the existing Glacier Prison, amplified.
kultivator.dpower.ult.shadow.desc: The Shadow Dao's book technique cast at +60%% damage and twice the radius. Cooldown 120 s.
kultivator.dpower.ult.shadow.source: Source: no new concept; the existing Gale, amplified.
kultivator.dpower.lotus.fusion_hint: %s is charging the Fire Lotus: press Fusion on its Talents page to fuse your flame with it!
kultivator.dpower.lotus.fizzle: %s's Fire Lotus finds no foe and fades.
kultivator.dpower.lotus.fused: You pour your flame into %s's lotus (%s qi).
kultivator.dpower.lotus.fused_blast: Master and disciple flames fused: %s's lotus bursts with doubled fury!
kultivator.dpower.why.ult_no_dao: It must choose a Dao first
kultivator.dpower.why.busy: Busy with a breakthrough or a Qi Deviation
kultivator.dpower.why.too_far: The target is too far away
kultivator.dpower.why.unsafe_centre: You or a villager stand too close to the target
kultivator.dpower.why.master_not_fire: Only a master of the Fire Dao can fuse flames
kultivator.dpower.why.master_far: Stand within 6 blocks of the disciple
kultivator.dpower.why.master_qi: Not enough qi (30%% of your maximum)
kultivator.dpower.flame.heading: Heavenly Flames
kultivator.dpower.flame.tooltip: Fed to a disciple: one with a Fire root, the Fire Dao, or anyone from Nascent Soul can absorb it.
kultivator.dpower.flame.tooltip_use: Right-click your disciple with it or feed it from its scroll, then guard the 20 s ritual (Hu Fa).
kultivator.dpower.flame.ritual: %s begins to absorb the %s. Guard it for %s seconds: stay within 8 blocks, meditating or sneaking still (Hu Fa).
kultivator.dpower.flame.fail: The %2$s rebels inside %1$s! Qi Deviation for %3$s seconds, and the seed comes back to you.
kultivator.dpower.flame.success_guarded: Under your guard, %s tames the %s! Heavenly Flames: %s/%s.
kultivator.dpower.flame.where.bone_chill: A stray slain by you or a disciple: 0.3%%
kultivator.dpower.flame.where.sea_heart: An Elder Guardian slain by you: sure the first time, then 25%%
kultivator.dpower.flame.where.fallen_hea: The Wither slain by you: sure the first time, then 25%%
kultivator.dpower.flame.count: Flames %s/%s · fire techniques +20%% each, burning blows, immune to fire
kultivator.dpower.flame.source: Source: Battle Through the Heavens: the ranked Heavenly Flames (Green Lotus Core Flame, Bone Chilling Flame, Sea Heart Flame, Fallen Heart Flame, Pure Lotus Demon Flame), and the Flame Mantra that grows by devouring them.
kultivator.dpower.why.flame_unfit: Needs a Fire root, the Fire Dao or Nascent Soul
kultivator.dpower.why.flame_full: Holds all the flames it can (3, one more per 9 stars)
kultivator.dpower.natal.heading: Natal Treasure
kultivator.dpower.natal.form.sword.desc: A life-bound flying sword. At fold 9: +10%% technique damage.
kultivator.dpower.natal.form.parasol.des: A sheltering parasol. At fold 9: every 60 s you and its fellow disciples within 4 blocks gain Absorption II for 10 s.
kultivator.dpower.natal.form.wok.desc: A wok like a turtle shell. At fold 9: -20%% damage taken.
kultivator.dpower.natal.form.bell.desc: A ringing bell. At fold 9: each of its casts gives the monsters within 6 blocks Slowness II for 3 s.
kultivator.dpower.natal.refine_cost: Refining once from Foundation: 1 diamond + 8 Spirit Tail Feathers (you have %s diamonds, %s feathers), inside your hall's territory. Choose its form:
kultivator.dpower.natal.refined: %s refines its natal treasure: a %s, bound to its life.
kultivator.dpower.natal.ability.sword.et: Payung Abadi: +20%% technique damage, and the sword circles its bearer.
kultivator.dpower.natal.ability.parasol: Fold 9: every 60 s, Absorption II for 10 s to you and the disciples within 4 blocks.
Payung Abadi: Absorption IV every 60 s, and the parasol circles its bearer.
kultivator.dpower.natal.ability.wok.eter: Payung Abadi: -40%% damage taken, and the wok circles its bearer.
kultivator.dpower.natal.ability.bell: Fold 9: Slowness II for 3 s on the monsters within 6 blocks at each cast.
kultivator.dpower.natal.ability.bell.ete: Payung Abadi: Slowness IV at each cast, and the bell circles its bearer.
kultivator.dpower.natal.ability.locked: Its ability awakens at fold 9; silver at fold 3, Payung Abadi at fold 14.
kultivator.dpower.natal.cost: Cost: %s Spirit Tail Feathers and %s PK from the sect pool
kultivator.dpower.natal.loss_risk: From fold 3 a failure breaks one fold
kultivator.dpower.natal.tiers: Each fold +5%% damage. Fold 3: silver sheen. Fold 9: gold and the form's ability. Fold 14: Payung Abadi, the ability doubles and the treasure orbits its bearer.
kultivator.dpower.natal.fold_ok: Spirit enhancement succeeds: %s's treasure reaches fold %s.
kultivator.dpower.natal.fold_fail: The enhancement of fold %2$s fails; %1$s's treasure stays at fold %3$s.
kultivator.dpower.natal.fold_lost: The enhancement of fold %2$s fails and a fold breaks: %1$s's treasure falls to fold %3$s.
kultivator.dpower.natal.milestone.9: %s's %s turns gold and awakens its ability (fold 9)!
kultivator.dpower.natal.milestone.14: Payung Abadi! %s's %s changes at its fourteenth enhancement: its ability doubles and it circles its bearer.
kultivator.dpower.natal.source: Source: A Will Eternal, ch. 5, 29-38, 637: Bai Xiaochun's spirit enhancement gives a silver sheen at one fold and later two- and threefold; elders stop at one or two folds because failure rises; his Eternal Parasol changes at its fourteenth enhancement; the three-coloured Spirit Tail flame is the fuel. A Record of a Mortal's Journey to Immortality: the 72 swords are Han Li's life-bound natal treasure.
kultivator.dpower.why.natal_has: Its natal treasure is already refined
kultivator.dpower.why.natal_territory: You must stand inside your Sect Hall's territory
kultivator.dpower.why.natal_materials: Needs 1 diamond and 8 Spirit Tail Feathers
kultivator.dpower.why.natal_max: The treasure holds no more folds
kultivator.dpower.why.natal_pool: Not enough PK in the sect pool
kultivator.dpower.codex.heading: Undying Codex
kultivator.dpower.codex.locked: Locked. Body Dao and Blocked Dantian disciples train it freely; others need the Undying Body Manual from the Yue Lu Pavilion.
kultivator.dpower.codex.stage.2.desc: Golden Skin (500): armor +12, toughness +4, immune to fire on its body, a golden glint
kultivator.dpower.codex.stage.3.desc: Undying Tendons (1,200): speed +15%%, dashes to its target (8 blocks, every 6 s)
kultivator.dpower.codex.stage.4.desc: Undying Bones (2,500): the Undying Emperor's Fist in any Dao (every 30 s)
kultivator.dpower.codex.stage.5.desc: Undying Blood (80 points per 1%%): +0.05 health a second per 10%%; at 100%%, once a day a deadly blow leaves it at 1 health, and +1%% max health per star
kultivator.dpower.codex.blood_full: %s's Undying Blood is complete: once a day, death cannot take it.
kultivator.dpower.codex.unbroken: Undying Blood! %s refuses to die and stands with 1 health.
kultivator.dpower.codex.source: Source: A Will Eternal: the Undying Live-Forever Codex's levels Undying Skin (Iron, Bronze, Silver, Gold Skin), Undying Tendons, Undying Bones (whose secret art is the Undying Emperor's Fist) and Undying Blood. The Heavenly King strength level is skipped as a simplification.
kultivator.dpower.kunpeng.name: Kunpeng Wings
kultivator.dpower.kunpeng.learned: %s unites the six Kunpeng bone pieces and learns the Kunpeng Wings!
kultivator.dpower.kunpeng.third: A third of the legacy: a 12-block dash with a wind crescent of 2 U on the monsters along its path. Full power after Void Realm floor 60. Every 20 s.
kultivator.dpower.kunpeng.full: Full power: a 24-block dash with a wind crescent of 6 U on the monsters along its path. Every 20 s.
kultivator.dpower.kunpeng.state_third: Kunpeng Wings: a third of the legacy
kultivator.dpower.kunpeng.source: Source: Perfect World, ch. 258-347: the Kunpeng's primordial bone is split into six parts that give only about a third of the legacy; the true technique lies in the Devil Refinement Cave and needs a higher realm to use fully.
kultivator.dpower.why.kunpeng_none: It has not learned the Kunpeng Wings
kultivator.dpower.why.no_path: No open path to dash through
kultivator.dpower.art.plum.desc: Every 4th melee or Sword technique hit looses a storm of petals (radius 4, 1.2 U). From Core Disciple, every 24th hit is Full Bloom (24 petals, radius 6, 2 U).
kultivator.dpower.art.purple_mist.desc: Qi regeneration ×1.3, max qi +20%% and a purple mist while meditating.
kultivator.dpower.art.northern.desc: +20%% damage at night and in snowy lands.
kultivator.dpower.art.source: Source: Return of the Mount Hua Sect: Chung Myung recovers Mount Hua's lost Twenty-Four Plum Blossom Sword and the Purple Mist Divine Art. Legend of the Northern Blade: Jin Mu-won learns the disbanded Northern Heavenly Sect's arts from fragmentary writings. Volcanic Age: techniques from the sect's hidden records.
kultivator.dpower.fairies.desc: Seven or more Core Disciples (or higher) of yours fight within 16 blocks of each other: each deals +10%% damage.
kultivator.dpower.fairies.source: Source: Against the Gods, ch. 739: the Frozen Cloud Seven Fairies, the sect's elite seven.
kultivator.dpower.fairies.linked: The Seven Fairies link their qi: seven lights, one formation (+10%% damage).
kultivator.dpower.soul_flight.fled: %s's body is destroyed, but its Nascent Soul flees to the Sect Hall as a streak of light. It re-forms there in %s minutes.
kultivator.dpower.soul_flight.source: Source: A Record of a Mortal's Journey (a Nascent Soul flees as a streak of light when its body is destroyed).
kultivator.screen.help.bakat.title: Talents, soul realms and rare physiques
kultivator.screen.help.bakat: Each disciple carries the colour of its soul realm, from Red (cultivation ×0.6) to Indigo (×1.7); a Red realm stops at Golden Core Peak unless good fortune lifts it (a Marrow Cleansing Pill, or meditating beside you while you meditate). Some have talents (Persevering Heart, Ancient God Blood, Pill Gift, Spirit Enhancer, Fear of Death, Sword Sense), a few a rare physique, and now and then a special candidate hides among the applicants. From Nascent Soul each Dao has a signature ultimate that the disciple casts by itself against bosses and crowds, or on your order from its Talents page. All of it hits monsters only and never touches a block. Hover over any line on the Talents page to read the story it comes from.
kultivator.screen.help.pusaka.title: Natal treasures, the Undying Codex and Heavenly Flames
kultivator.screen.help.pusaka: From Foundation a disciple can refine one natal treasure (Sword, Parasol, Wok or Bell) with a diamond and Spirit Tail Feathers inside your hall's territory, then temper it fold by fold with feathers and sect PK: each fold +5%% damage, silver at 3, gold and the form's ability at 9, Payung Abadi at 14; from fold 3 a failure breaks a fold. The Undying Codex hardens the body through the blows it survives, up to Undying Blood that refuses death once a day. Heavenly Flame seeds drop from blazes, strays, the Elder Guardian, the Wither and the Ender Dragon; feed one to a fitting disciple and guard its 20-second ritual.
advancement.kultivator.rare_physique.des: Have a disciple with a rare physique
advancement.kultivator.heretic_gates.des: See a disciple's ordinary veins open as the Heretic God Veins
advancement.kultivator.signature_ultimat: Watch a disciple unleash the signature ultimate of its Dao
advancement.kultivator.heavenly_flame.de: Help a disciple absorb a Heavenly Flame
advancement.kultivator.buddha_lotus_fusi: Fuse your flame into your disciple's Buddha's Fury Fire Lotus
advancement.kultivator.natal_fold_9.desc: Temper a disciple's natal treasure to fold 9
